en-US.description: Video editing, color and sound; an open-source, clean-room reimplementation of Adobe Premiere Pro, rebuilt in pure Rust
en-US.longDescription:
Video editing, color and sound; an open-source, clean-room reimplementation of Adobe Premiere Pro, rebuilt in pure Rust.
An open-source, clean-room take on the Adobe Premiere Pro workflow: native on macOS, Windows and Linux, and in the browser via WebAssembly. By the ArtCraft team.
Premiere 26's full Video Effects bin (93 effects in 16 folders), the Legacy bin and the obsolete effects old projects use, plus around 30 transitions.
en-US.name: FilmCraft
en-US.releaseNotes:
Note
No FreeBSD aarch64 build in this release. We are having trouble building this architecture within the 5-hour CI timeout across all Craft apps, so we are releasing without it to unblock builds. FreeBSD x86_64 and every other platform are included. FreeBSD aarch64 builds will return once the build fits in CI.
What's Changed
- Skip GPU goldens when Rgba32Float is not renderable by @vbasky in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/1315
- [agent] Dialog buttons show the pointing hand on hover by @alexng353 in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/1777
- Graphics: an outer stroke with Fill off draws only the ring outside the edge by @marcoarnulfo in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/1881
- cli: reject deeply nested dotted parameters before parsing by @Ni-zav in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/1936
- Reject .3dl LUTs whose input mesh is larger than 256 entries by @Silvertree2010 in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/2082
- fix(export): tag SDR exports with a colr box (#2142) by @ssandweiss in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/2144
- Captions: default TTML tick rate follows the frame rate multiplier by @webdevtodayjason in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/1761
- matroska: bound recursive chapter and tag parsing by @Ni-zav in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/1935
- fix(effect-controls): a dropped graph keyframe stays where it was dropped by @marcoarnulfo in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/2026
- Reject non-numeric --seconds and --scale in CLI render by @Silvertree2010 in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/2141
- Refuse numbers separated by spaces or a unit in number fields by @Silvertree2010 in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/2261
- monitor: the Source waveform follows the time ruler's zoom by @marcoarnulfo in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/1797
- #1871: Lens Blur works out its disc offsets once per frame, not per pixel by @Guilhermeb-Ferrarezi in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/1907
- Saturate crop and field-height math on hostile Matroska/MXF/AAF headers by @Ni-zav in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/1937
- fix(engine): enable Multi-Camera Enable/Flatten only for clips they work on by @ssandweiss in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/2090
- fix(cfb): adding a child is O(1), not a scan of every sibling (AAF export of 20 000 markers took a minute) by @Wbunker in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/2290

- codecs: the pixel-format label comes from the SPS before the avcC/hvcC fields by @wstock in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/2016
- #1544: an export started without wait says where to follow it (jobs.list, jobs.cancel) by @00xJS in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/2125
- captions: pin the setStyle margin contract with a regression test; clearer track error (#1542) by @notdezzi in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/1655
- #1922: Audio Clip Mixer strips narrow to fit the panel, and scroll when they cannot by @marcoarnulfo in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/1927
- ci: configure Dependabot for Cargo and GitHub Actions by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/2374
- Fix "-0.000" in Seconds time display for tiny negative times by @Silvertree2010 in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/2479

zh-CN.description: 视频剪辑、调色与声音；以纯 Rust 全新重写的开源 Adobe Premiere Pro 净室重实现
zh-CN.longDescription:
视频剪辑、调色与声音；一个以纯 Rust 全新重写的开源 Adobe Premiere Pro 净室重实现。
对 Adobe Premiere Pro 工作流的开源净室重现：macOS、Windows 和 Linux 原生应用，并可通过 WebAssembly 在浏览器中使用。由 ArtCraft 团队打造。
包含 Premiere 26 的完整视频效果箱（16 个文件夹中的 93 种效果）、传统效果箱和旧项目使用的过时效果，以及约 30 种转场。
